HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   D. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   C. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.

5. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   B. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   D. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   B. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

8. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.

9. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   D. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.

12. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   D. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The 2nd Generation of Industrial revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Conflict, Transformation and Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Digital divide and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Inclusivity and Interdependence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Explain symbols used on a map

2. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

3. B — Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A — Plan income and spending wisely

8. C — Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. B — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A — Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The 2nd Generation of Industrial revolution; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Conflict, Transformation and Peace; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Digital divide; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Inclusivity and Interdependence; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
